title: 3D character reference sheet
description: Orthographic character model sheet (front, side and back in an A-pose or T-pose) with readable face and hands, for 3D character modelling.

guidance: Ask for a character model sheet: front, side and back views of one character side by side on one compact landscape sheet (about 3:2, the requested size).
One neutral A-pose or T-pose, identical in every view; arms held clear of the body so the silhouette and the hands read.
Give the face and hands enough pixels to model from: a readable face in the front view, open hands with distinct fingers.
Same scale and aligned baselines in every view; each view fills most of the sheet height, never a long thin strip of small figures.
Neutral lighting: flat, even light on a plain light neutral background, no cast shadows, no perspective.
avoid: long thin strip of small views

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear subject and its role in the game.
The prompt states the style, framing and background the purpose requires.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example transparent background and a full scene).
The prompt fixes orthographic views, one A-pose or T-pose and scale consistency.
The prompt asks for a readable face and clearly separated fingers.
image_rubric: The image shows the subject the prompt asked for, without extra subjects.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.
No anatomical, perspective or structural errors that block the target use.
Front, side and back views are present and consistent in proportions, costume and pose.
Views share scale and baseline; no perspective distortion.
The face and both hands are visible and detailed enough to model from (distinct fingers).

constraints.lighting: Flat, even neutral lighting with no cast shadows, rim light or dramatic key light.
